questions.question: What should you do when you see a triangular school warning sign ahead?
options: Slow down and watch carefully for children
Keep driving at 30 mph if the road is straight
Sound your horn to warn children
questions.explanation: Highway Code Rule 208 says to drive slowly near schools and watch for children.

questions.question: Why should you drop your speed past parked cars outside a school?
options: Children are small and can step out without warning
Parked cars always open their right doors
Speed cameras only work below 20 mph
questions.explanation: Slower speed gives you room to stop if a child steps out.

questions.question: What happens if you pass a school sign at 30 mph with pedestrians nearby?
options: It counts as a serious fault
questions.explanation: Speeding past a school with pedestrians nearby is a serious fault.
